projects.title: Sovereign Office Architecture
projects.tagline: Separated offices, protected dissent, explicit human authority, bounded operation, signed-envelope lineage, and receipted repair.
projects.story: Sovereign Office Architecture separates observation, dependency mapping, dissent, governance, operation, and repair so one intelligence cannot silently observe, judge, authorize, execute, and excuse itself. The current public package preserves the v1.2 final baseline and v1.3 alpha lineage—including Bridge Runner, Operator Authority, Signed Envelopes, and Freeze Drift—while keeping the boundary clear that office labels and sealed prompts do not by themselves prove independence.
projects.summary: Observer, Cartographer, Protected Dissenter, Governor, Operator, and Repairer produce distinct judgments around a human-approved mandate. Agreement may inform a decision, but it cannot manufacture authority, erase dissent, expand scope, or convert correlated outputs into independent evidence.
projects.see: The six-office architecture, separation map, packet-to-receipt flow, v1.2/v1.3 lineage, Freeze Drift rule, independence boundary, fixed-data Sealed Office Council Drill, and PAT Mk.1 Governance Mode.
projects.proof: Seven public artifacts are connected. The council drill uses four fixed synthetic packets and no model calls. It demonstrates sealed judgments, preserved dissent, missing-authority refusal, majority-versus-admissibility, correlated-output caution, bounded authorization language, and demonstration-only receipt previews.
projects.next: Freeze a portable signed-envelope fixture containing a decision packet, six independently produced judgments, protected dissent identity, human authority capsule, bounded operator envelope, result receipt, repair path, and replay manifest. Then run a heterogeneous-model adversarial trial that measures correlated failure rather than assuming independence.
projects.claimBoundary: This package demonstrates governance architecture, fixed synthetic office judgments, public explanation, and Archive integration. It does not prove model independence, collusion resistance, correct reasoning, legal authority, secure signatures, safe autonomous operation, production readiness, or reliable governance outcomes. No office may authorize itself; majority agreement cannot override missing authority or constitutional dissent; and repair may never erase the original event or receipt.

relationships.note: Double C supplies the public relationship language; SOSA supplies the separated governance structure beneath it.
ALO preserves packets, judgments, authority, dissent, operation, repair, and replay evidence.
Graph Cinema replays the receipted motion produced by SOSA decisions without becoming the source of truth.
Coherence Bridge applies SOSA-style drift, dissent, pause, and repair to human-continuity systems.
The Institute provides public stewardship, founding authority, and project-level mandate context.
